items.title: CymruSec 2026
items.summary: This is the 2nd annual CymruSec Summit, the Welsh edition of DIGIT's Cybersecurity series.The event brings together senior cyber practitioners, industry experts, IT specialists, security researchers and law enforcement - providing a unique forum for knowledge exchange, discussion and high-level networking.The programme is focused on improving awareness and best practice through shared learning; highlighting emerging threats, new research, and changing adversarial tactics, whilst examining practical ways to improve resilience and response.This Summit is geared for senior Cyber, InfoSec, IT personnel & C-level leaders.
